name: ProofRoute feature request
about: Propose a proof-first improvement for routing, proxying, classifier acceleration, telemetry, terminal UX, or launch polish.
title: ""

assignees: ""
---

Describe the developer workflow this feature would make faster, cheaper, safer, or easier to trust. The best proposals start from a real Vibe Coding moment, such as a coding agent choosing between local and cloud models, a sidecar proving accelerator readiness, a ledger turning private traffic into a shareable receipt, or a maintainer trying to keep the repository face sharp before launch.

Explain the proof that should exist when the feature is done. ProofRoute features should usually leave behind a command, terminal receipt, SVG card, JSON artifact, browser-readable header, telemetry aggregate, or CI gate that makes the value visible without requiring a hosted dashboard or exporting prompt text.

Describe the privacy boundary and compatibility expectation. Mention whether the feature changes prompt handling, completion handling, provider credentials, local endpoint metadata, OpenAI-compatible API behavior, virtual policy models, classifier sidecar contracts, or repository-facing copy.

Share the smallest implementation shape you can imagine. A useful request names the affected layer in the Agent-View-Controller architecture and explains why the change belongs there, while still leaving room for maintainers to choose the simplest code path that protects zero-dependency installation and terminal-first ergonomics.
